features.title: Smart menu builder
features.description: Build your full menu with photos, prices, add-ons, and removals. Go live in minutes.

features.title: Cutoffs & automated emails
features.description: Set ordering deadlines per delivery date. Order confirmations, cutoff reminders, and cancellation receipts go out to customers automatically.

features.title: Stripe payments
features.description: Every order paid up front via Stripe. Funds go straight to your connected account.

features.title: Multi-location support
features.description: Serve any number of locations from a single dashboard, each with its own delivery schedule.

features.title: Live order dashboard
features.description: See every order in real time. Export kitchen sheets, track payments, manage refunds.

features.title: Auto label printing
features.description: Print individual kitchen labels for every order — name, allergens, add-ons. No manual sorting.

features.title: Discount module
features.description: Create promo codes, percentage or flat discounts, and set usage limits — applied automatically at checkout.

features.title: Multi-day checkout
features.description: Customers can order across multiple delivery dates in a single checkout — fewer drop-offs, more committed orders.
